### Changed
- **The kagent line re-pins to `v0.11.0-gs.9`** (`components.kagent` and `components.kagent-crds` floor, `examples/customer-bom.yaml`; giantswarm/giantswarm#37742 row 41): the line's ninth release carries the Harness template that drops an empty-valued selector label (above); the pin and the other carried patches are those of `gs.8`.
### Fixed
- **The platform Harness admits templates by the platform label alone on an installation whose kagent HelmRelease pre-existed the cut-over** (giantswarm/agent-platform#418): the meta chart removed the kagent chart's own default selector key `kagent.dev/harness` by forwarding a null (`components.kagent.nullKeys`), which deletes the key on coalesce — but a kagent `HelmRelease` that existed on 3.x is *patched* by the upgrade, and a JSON merge patch removes a null key instead of storing it, so the chart default came back and the live Harness required both `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/harness` and `kagent.dev/harness` while the Generic agent chart 1.x stamps only the first: no `AgentTemplate` was admitted (graveler, 2026-09-13; a freshly created release — spidertron — kept the null). The meta chart now forwards `kagent.dev/harness: ""` in `kagent.harness.allowedAgentTemplates.selector.matchLabels`, a value create and patch store alike, and the kagent line's Harness template drops every selector label whose value is empty (`v0.11.0-gs.9`, giantswarm/kagent-upstream#26; a selector left with nothing fails the render there). `components.kagent.nullKeys` and the `agent-platform.setNull` helper are removed — nothing else used them. `verify-kagent-harness` now also replays the forwarded values as a merge patch onto a pre-existing release, coalesces the chart's default over them and asserts the effective selector is the platform label alone, and refuses any null in the kagent release's values; `verify-components-charts` asserts the Harness the resolved kagent chart renders from the forwarded values selects by `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/harness` only.
